touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Burford qualifies as a local detour through Castle Tump, a motte castle and causeway, 150m west of Teme Bridge and CHURCH OF ST MARY. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.
